1: // Asteroid Dodger – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
9:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);
10: 
11:   // ----- Sound assets -----
12:   const sounds = {
13:     thrust: new Audio('thrust.wav'),
14:     explosion: new Audio('explosion.wav'),
15:     shield: new Audio('shield.wav'),
16:     powerup: new Audio('powerup.wav'),
17:     gameover: new Audio('gameover.wav'),
18:   };
19:   // set volume levels
20:   sounds.thrust.volume = 0.3;
21:   sounds.explosion.volume = 0.4;
22:   sounds.shield.volume = 0.5;
23:   sounds.powerup.volume = 0.5;
24:   sounds.gameover.volume = 0.6;
25: 
26: 
27:   // ----- Game objects -----
28:   const ship = {
29:     x: width / 2,
30:     y: height / 2,
31:     angle: 0,
32:     vx: 0,
33:     vy: 0,
34:     radius: 10,
35:     shield: false,
36:     shieldTimer: 0,
37:     thrusting: false,
38:   };
39: 
40:   // starfield for background
41:   const stars = [];
42:   const STAR_COUNT = 120;
43:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
44:     stars.push({
45:       x: Math.random() * width,
46:       y: Math.random() * height,
47:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
48:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
49:     });
50:   }
51: 
52:   function drawStars() {
53:     ctx.save();
54:     stars.forEach(s => {
55:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
56:       ctx.beginPath();
57:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
58:       ctx.fill();
59:     });
60:     ctx.restore();
61:   }
62: 
63:   // particle system for explosions
64:   const particles = [];
65:   class Particle {
66:     constructor(x, y) {
67:       this.x = x;
68:       this.y = y;
69:       const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
70:       const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
71:       this.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
72:       this.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
73:       this.radius = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
74:       this.life = Math.random() * 30 + 30; // frames
75:     }
76:     update() {
77:       this.x += this.vx;
78:       this.y += this.vy;
79:       this.life--;
80:     }
81:     draw() {
82:       ctx.save();
83:       ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(this.life / 60, 0);
84:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
85:       ctx.beginPath();
86:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
87:       ctx.fill();
88:       ctx.restore();
89:     }
90:   }
91:   function spawnExplosion(x, y) {
92:     const count = 20;
93:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
94:       particles.push(new Particle(x, y));
95:     }
96:   }
97: 
98:   function updateParticles() {
99:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
100:       const p = particles[i];
101:       p.update();
102:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function drawParticles() {
107:     particles.forEach(p => p.draw());
108:   }
109: 
110:   // power‑up with glow
111:   class PowerUp {
112:     constructor() {
113:       this.x = Math.random() * width;
114:       this.y = Math.random() * height;
115:       this.baseRadius = 8;
116:       this.radius = this.baseRadius;
117:       this.active = true;
118:       this.pulse = 0;
119:     }
120:     draw() {
121:       if (!this.active) return;
122:       this.pulse += 0.1;
123:       this.radius = this.baseRadius + Math.sin(this.pulse) * 2;
124:       ctx.save();
125:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
126:       ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
127:       ctx.shadowColor = 'lime';
128:       ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
129:       ctx.beginPath();
130:       ctx.arc(0, 0, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
131:       ctx.fill();
132:       ctx.restore();
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136: 
137: 
138:   class Asteroid {
139:     constructor() {
140:       const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
141:       // spawn on random edge
142:       if (edge === 0) { // top
143:         this.x = Math.random() * width;
144:         this.y = -20;
145:       } else if (edge === 1) { // right
146:         this.x = width + 20;
147:         this.y = Math.random() * height;
148:       } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
149:         this.x = Math.random() * width;
150:         this.y = height + 20;
151:       } else { // left
152:         this.x = -20;
153:         this.y = Math.random() * height;
154:       }
155:       const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
156:       const angle = Math.atan2(ship.y - this.y, ship.x - this.x);
157:       this.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
158:       this.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
159:       this.radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
160:       // rotation for visual flair
161:       this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
162:       this.rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
163:     }
164:     update() {
165:       this.x += this.vx;
166:       this.y += this.vy;
167:       this.rotation += this.rotSpeed;
168:       // wrap around
169:       if (this.x < -30) this.x = width + 30;
170:       if (this.x > width + 30) this.x = -30;
171:       if (this.y < -30) this.y = height + 30;
172:       if (this.y > height + 30) this.y = -30;
173:     }
174:     draw() {
175:       ctx.save();
176:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
177:       ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
178:       // rocky gradient
179:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, this.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, this.radius);
180:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
181:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
182:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
183:       ctx.beginPath();
184:       ctx.arc(0, 0, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
185:       ctx.fill();
186:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#111';
187:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
188:       ctx.stroke();
189:       ctx.restore();
190:     }
191:   }
192: 
193: 
194: 
195:   const asteroids = [];
196:   let powerUp = null;
197:   let gameOver = false;
198: 
199:   // ----- Input handling -----
200:   const keys = {};
201:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
202:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
203: 
204:   function updateShip() {
205:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 0.07;
206:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 0.07;
207:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
208:       const thrust = 0.1;
209:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
210:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
211:       ship.thrusting = true;
212:       // play thrust sound (restart to allow rapid repeats)
213:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
214:       sounds.thrust.play();
215:     } else {
216:       ship.thrusting = false;
217:     }
218:     // apply friction
219:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
220:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
221:     ship.x += ship.vx;
222:     ship.y += ship.vy;
223:     // wrap ship
224:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
225:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
226:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
227:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
228:     // shield timer
229:     if (ship.shield) {
230:       ship.shieldTimer -= 1 / 60;
231:       if (ship.shieldTimer <= 0) ship.shield = false;
232:     }
233:   }
234: 
235:   function spawnAsteroid() {
236:     if (asteroids.length < 10) asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
237:   }
238: 
239:   function spawnPowerUp() {
240:     if (!powerUp) powerUp = new PowerUp();
241:   }
242: 
243:   function checkCollisions() {
244:     // ship vs asteroids
245:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
246:       const a = asteroids[i];
247:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
248:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
249:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
250:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
251:         if (ship.shield) {
252:           // destroy asteroid, consume shield
253:           const exX = a.x;
254:           const exY = a.y;
255:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
256:           ship.shield = false;
257:           spawnExplosion(exX, exY);
258:           sounds.explosion.play();
259:           sounds.shield.play();
260:         } else {
261:           gameOver = true;
262:           sounds.explosion.play();
263:           sounds.gameover.play();
264:         }
265:       }
266:     }
267:     // ship vs power‑up
268:     if (powerUp && powerUp.active) {
269:       const dx = powerUp.x - ship.x;
270:       const dy = powerUp.y - ship.y;
271:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < powerUp.radius + ship.radius) {
272:         ship.shield = true;
273:         ship.shieldTimer = 5; // seconds
274:         powerUp.active = false;
275:         powerUp = null;
276:         sounds.shield.play();
277:         sounds.powerup.play();
278:       }
279:     }
280:   }
281: 
282:   function drawShip() {
283:     ctx.save();
284:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
285:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
286:     // ship body with subtle gradient
287:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -12, 0, 12);
288:     grad.addColorStop(0, ship.shield ? 'cyan' : '#99d');
289:     grad.addColorStop(1, ship.shield ? '#33f' : '#fff');
290:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
291:     ctx.beginPath();
292:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
293:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
294:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
295:     ctx.closePath();
296:     ctx.fill();
297:     // thrust flame
298:     if (ship.thrusting) {
299:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
300:       ctx.beginPath();
301:       ctx.moveTo(-8, -4);
302:       ctx.lineTo(-14, 0);
303:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 4);
304:       ctx.closePath();
305:       ctx.fill();
306:     }
307:     ctx.restore();
308:   }
309: 
310:   function draw() {
311:     // dark space background
312:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000020';
313:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
314:     // stars
315:     drawStars();
316:     // ship and objects
317:     drawShip();
318:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.draw());
319:     // particles
320:     drawParticles();
321:     if (powerUp) powerUp.draw();
322:     if (gameOver) {
323:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
324:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
325:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
326:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
327:     }
328:   }
329: 
330:   // ----- Main loop -----
331:   let lastAsteroidSpawn = 0;
332:   let lastPowerSpawn = 0;
333:   function loop(timestamp) {
334:     if (gameOver) { draw(); return; }
335:     const delta = timestamp - (lastAsteroidSpawn || timestamp);
336:     if (delta > 2000) { // spawn every 2 seconds
337:       spawnAsteroid();
338:       lastAsteroidSpawn = timestamp;
339:     }
340:     if (timestamp - lastPowerSpawn > 10000) { // power‑up every 10 s
341:       spawnPowerUp();
342:       lastPowerSpawn = timestamp;
343:     }
344:     updateShip();
345:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.update());
346:     updateParticles();
347:     checkCollisions();
348:     draw();
349:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
350:   }
351: 
352:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
353: })();
